text:
[RLOW.7.1.2] Where the target schema declares `ts`, the `TerminalNode`'s emit action
carries no value for it, and the runtime fills it with the wall clock's current sample as a
UTC `Time` ([LTIM.2.8.3], [LFAC.9.2]), so an emitted fact's `ts` is source time
like an adapter's.

idris.name: rlow_7_1_2__emitted
idris.note: AN EMITTED FACT: its `ts` is the wall sample, its entry stamp the monotonic one ([LTIM.2.8.6]). RLOW.7.1.2 as drafted; the definition follows the clause if it changes.

idris.name: rlow_7_1_2__emitted_ts_replays
idris.note: EVERY EMITTED FACT HAS ON REPLAY THE `ts` AND THE STAMP IT HAD, for every clock source, every run and every starting clocks of the replay: the samples replay (TwoClocks.idr) and an emitted fact is a function of its sample. A one-line corollary, kept because it is the sentence RLOW.7.1.2 and [LTIM.2.8.5] make together.
